name: Fairytale Thief: Hansel & Gretel
source:
Do not, I repeat, do NOT let the witch eat you.


What do you mean 'why'? 

Uh, your sibling would be mad?

The world (probably) needs you alive!

Being dinner sounds terrible on a resume-

It's a sign of bad luck too-

listen, it might be tempting and all but DO NOT LET THE WITCH EAT YOU


What else can you do, you ask?

Why yes, you can try and romance the witch

but if you fail....

[From [url=https://jewelswithwings.itch.io/fairytale-thief-hansel-gretel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我再说一遍，不要让女巫吃掉你。


你说‘为什么’是什么意思？

呃，你弟弟会生气吗？

世界（可能）需要你活着！

简历上的晚餐听起来很糟糕——

这也是运气不好的征兆

听着，这可能很诱人，但不要让女巫吃掉你


你问你还能做什么？

为什么是的，你可以尝试和女巫谈恋爱

但如果你失败了……

[来自[url=https://jewelswithwings.itch.io/fairytale-thief-hansel-gretel]itch.io[/url]]
